rationale: The claim is covered under section 3 (Trip Delay): the carrier's confirmation shows a 9 hour 20 minute delay from a crew duty-time limit, which is beyond the Premium plan's 6 hour waiting period, and the documented hotel ($112), meal ($58) and taxi ($40) costs come to $210, under the $800 plan maximum with no deductible. However, this is the customer's third claim filed within 12 months (CLM-0874 on 2025-10-03 and CLM-0951 on 2026-03-18), so under section 9 of the claims manual it must go to the Special Investigations Unit for review before payment. The claim appears payable at $210 and needs SIU review plus a claims handler sign-off recorded before payment.
